_comment: Recurring IT/CH demand peaks. score.py proposes the related guide or freshness update 4-8 weeks before a peak, and only when (1) owner_reviewed_on is set, (2) the entry's status is 'checked' and (3) checked_for_year equals the year of the coming peak. Every date needs an official source, re-checked every year. The agent never edits this file.
OWNER_READ_REQUIRED: One-time read by the owner: check each date and source, then set owner_reviewed_on to the date of your read. Until then no seasonal candidate is made.

entries.title: IMU, saldo
entries.source_note: L. 160/2019, art. 1 c. 762: acconto 16 June, saldo 16 December. Seen restated in municipal IMU regulations on finanze.gov.it; the law text itself not re-read.

entries.title: 730 precompilato: consultation opens
entries.source_note: 2026 campaign: available from 30 April, sending from 14/15 May (the two AdE pages disagree), deadline 30 September. Re-check when AdE publishes the 2027 calendar.

entries.title: Redditi PF: deadline
entries.source_note: 2026: 2 November (31 October fell on a Saturday). The rule behind the date not re-read.

entries.title: New IRPEF brackets after the budget law
entries.source_note: Only from the law as published in the Gazzetta Ufficiale, never from the DDL. Set checked_for_year once it is published.

entries.title: Assegno unico: new ISEE by end of February
entries.source_note: Needs the INPS message for the year.

entries.title: Certificazione Unica to employees
entries.source_note: Needs the AdE page for the year.

entries.title: Tredicesima (December pay)
entries.source_note: No single legal date: paid in December under the CCNL; pensions with the December instalment (INPS). Needs the INPS payment calendar for the year.

entries.title: New withholding-tax tables
entries.source_note: ESTV circular no. 221 (20 Oct 2026): 2027 tables valid from 1 January 2027; files expected online in December 2026. Cantonal tables only on each canton's site.

entries.title: Pillar 3a: pay in before 31 December
entries.source_note: Federal announcement of 5 Oct 2026: max CHF 7,258 (with 2nd pillar) for 2026, CHF 7,373 from 1 Jan 2027; without 2nd pillar CHF 36,288 / 36,864.

entries.title: Cantonal tax-return deadlines
entries.source_note: Differs by canton: each canton's own page is the source. One entry per canton once checked.
